text:
Matthew Tkachuk is back to full speed after a season cut to 31 games, and he is setting up everything: 33 points in 25 games, 26 of them assists and 19 on the power play. NHL.com's notebook flagged his point streak on Nov. 19, and he scored twice in a loss to Edmonton two nights earlier.

Nothing here screams luck. His goals match his expected goals (the quality of his chances), and Florida takes 58% of the shot attempts at five-on-five when he's out there. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 95th percentile for primary shot assists last season, though in only six tracked games. The thing to watch is ice time. He has averaged 17.5 minutes over his last ten games, about a minute and a half below his season mark, with three of those games under 15 minutes. Our numbers project about 94 points if the role holds. He scores at a rate of 4.32 points per 60 minutes, so every minute he gets matters.
headline: Tkachuk's power play is doing the work
